time.title: Time and calendar
time.description: Choose the time and date format for your business.
time.dstNote: Daylight savings changes will automatically apply based on your selected time zone
time.processingLabel: Display processing time segments within appointment tiles
time.processingHint: Extra processing time that is part of an appointment will be shown as a faded segment in the same color as the appointment tile.
time.blockedLabel: Highlight blocked time segments within appointment tiles
time.blockedHint: Extra blocked time that is part of an appointment will be shown as a grey segment within the appointment tile.

waitlist.title: Waitlist
waitlist.description: Enable a waitlist online and choose how waitlisted clients are offered a time slot.

manual.label: You pick
manual.hint: Manually select a client from the waitlist

auto.label: Automatically book
auto.hint: Automatically notify clients on the waitlist

waitlist.priorityHint: Choose how you would like to prioritise your clients on the waitlist

first.label: First in line
first.hint: Automatically offer to clients in order of when they joined the waitlist

highest_value.label: Highest value
highest_value.hint: Automatically offer to clients in order of highest value appointment

all.label: Offer to all
all.hint: Automatically offer to all clients on the waitlist. First client to book gets the slot

waitlist.notificationsText: Configure how clients are notified about the waitlist in
waitlist.selectTypeHint: Choose how you would like to book clients from the waitlist
waitlist.onlineDisabled: Online bookings are disabled. Clients will not be able to book appointments online when time slots are available
waitlist.allowOnline: Allow clients to join waitlist online
waitlist.allowOnlineHint: Client can add themselves to the waitlist while booking online
waitlist.anyTime: Clients can request any preferred time
waitlist.anyTimeHint: Clients are able to choose any date and time when joining the waitlist
waitlist.openOnly: Clients can only request times that your business is open
waitlist.openOnlyHint: Clients are only able to choose dates and times within your location opening hours. Manage your opening hours in

btt.title: Blocked time types
btt.description: Create and customize blocked times that can be scheduled in the calendar.
btt.addSubtitle: Create a new blocked time type
btt.nameRequired: Enter a name for this blocked time type
btt.emptyBody: Create blocked time types like lunch or training so your team can block time in the calendar.
btt.deleteBody: "{{name}}" will no longer be available in the calendar. Blocked times already scheduled stay as they are.

resources.title: Resources
resources.description: Add resources, rooms and other resources needed for your services.
resources.emptyBody: Manage bookable resources, rooms and equipment required for your services
resources.capacityMany: Up to {{count}} appointments at a time
resources.typesDescription: Group resources by type so services can require a room, chair or other equipment.
resources.typesEmptyBody: Create a type such as Room or Chair to organise your resources.
resources.typeInUse: Can't be deleted while resources use it
resources.typeDuplicate: A resource type with this name already exists
resources.deleteBody: "{{name}}" will be removed. Existing appointments keep their history.
resources.deleteTypeBody: "{{name}}" will be removed from your services.
